title: Exceptions to Height Regulations

blocks.html: For any development, the City Planning Commission may grant a special permit to modify the height regulations as set forth in Section 23-42 (Height and Setback Requirements in R1 Through R5 Districts) and Section 107-43, provided that the Commission finds that:
blocks.plainText: For any development, the City Planning Commission may grant a special permit to modify the height regulations as set forth in Section 23-42 (Height and Setback Requirements in R1 Through R5 Districts) and Section 107-43, provided that the Commission finds that:

blocks.html: (a)        such development is so located as not to impair the essential character of the surrounding area;
blocks.plainText: (a) such development is so located as not to impair the essential character of the surrounding area;

blocks.html: (b)        by concentrating permitted floor area in a building or buildings of greater height covering less land, the preservation of existing topography, designated open space or the protection of an outstanding view from a public space, will be assured, and that such preservation would not be possible by careful siting of lower buildings containing the same permitted floor area and covering more land; and
blocks.plainText: (b) by concentrating permitted floor area in a building or buildings of greater height covering less land, the preservation of existing topography, designated open space or the protection of an outstanding view from a public space, will be assured, and that such preservation would not be possible by careful siting of lower buildings containing the same permitted floor area and covering more land; and

blocks.html: (c)        that the development's design proposals take full advantage of all special characteristics of the site.
blocks.plainText: (c) that the development's design proposals take full advantage of all special characteristics of the site.

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) such development is so located as not to impair the essential character of the surrounding area;

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) by concentrating permitted floor area in a building or buildings of greater height covering less land, the preservation of existing topography, designated open space or the protection of an outstanding view from a public space, will be assured, and that such preservation would not be possible by careful siting of lower buildings containing the same permitted floor area and covering more land; and

subsections.label: (c)
subsections.plainText: (c) that the development's design proposals take full advantage of all special characteristics of the site.
